titulo: Introducing two people? Give each one a fact
caption:
Introducing two people? Give each one a fact

Two people just met. Cella gives him one fact about her and gives her one fact about him. Now each has a first question.

For whoever gives each person one thing to start with.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with a voice on a flat color background in a lavender room. At the top, the words: 2 people just met. 1 fact each. Three small doorway-shaped figures with white eyes stand in a row, each a different color, the black one in the middle. The words appear one line at a time: I stand between them. To him: she's learning to bake (the middle figure turns left and a speech bubble says she's learning to bake). To her: he's back from Lisbon (it turns right and a bubble says he's back from Lisbon). Now they have a first question (the two outer figures turn toward each other, one says Lisbon, the other says baking, both smile and a star appears). The closing line: for whoever gives each person a way in. Then: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: Cella gave each of them one fact. Somebody asked about Lisbon.
evolucion: Tres apuestas (junta-ene-s3, seccion 3). (a) El cierre con persona, sin pedido: ninguna pieza pide guardar, comentar, compartir, enviar ni seguir (regla 8); el fijado es una frase de Cella que nombra al destinatario. Base de lectura: N2 16 % (14 de 88 Reels), 1,5 envios por 1.000 de alcance, mediana de alcance 117; con el mismo corte de la hora 168. (b) El destinatario como gancho: brazo A (abre con "For whoever ..." en el cuadro 0 y vuelve a cerrar) contra brazo B (solo cierra). Se mide a 48 h con medir.py (envios por 1.000 de alcance, vistas comprometidas) y a 7 dias con objetivos.py (N2, N4). Con 17 seguidores no separa causa de ruido: lectura de orden de magnitud. (c) Hora (apuesta 3a): tres Shorts a las 23:00Z contra tres a las 17:00Z; sin el si de N salen todos a las 17:00Z y el campo apuesta_hora de pieza.json dice cual es el brazo.
